description: The CA-RDQN package selects four of 12 process sensors every 15 minutes in BSM1. It includes trained checkpoints, 495 feasible sensor configurations, causal estimation and evaluation scripts. This resource is provided by Blakk, Clinton; Nwulu, Nnamdi; Akinlabi, Esther. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: MIT. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Original BSM1 input files must be obtained separately. This is a study reproducibility release. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis.
